name: ao_axis
scope: CPU coefficient schedules, CUDA radial-free expressions and conservative region coefficient operators differentiate the same Cartesian Gaussian monomial primal. Region lowering takes absolute AD contributions before cancellation, preserves directed rounding and verifies affine-band compression over its complete bounded degree domain. CPU evaluation keeps zero-coefficient IEEE arithmetic and one radial factor per primitive/AO/point. Traversal, jet ordering, accumulation and admission remain.
